residual_risks: The definition is derived from the runs and run_attempts schema and the Run state machine and recorded in the Context Map; a later change to what a Run references makes that line and this record wrong together.
Five reviewed records plus this term cover two of the repository's Bounded Contexts; the rest of the Context Map remains unmodelled.
The pre-push hook that checks signatures is local, so a machine without it, or a push with --no-verify, does not enforce this policy.
